about: The fixed Lucy evaluation set (docs/saas/09-lucy-ai-gateway.md 9.6, ADR-0404 SC-0404-06). Synthetic libraries and scripted requests. selecta.ai.evaluation runs every case against a deployment and the gate passes only when every case passes. Change it only with a new version number: reports name the version they ran.

cases.checks: A warm half hour: the right mood and close to the asked length.
cases.request: Make me about 30 minutes of warm, easy house.

cases.checks: Songs the person ruled out never appear.
cases.request: A warm 20 minutes, but leave out Glow and anything by Field C.

cases.checks: Every song named is in the library, even when asked for one that isn't.
cases.request: Peak-time 15 minutes, and put in Sandstorm if I have it.

cases.checks: Asked only to extend, the current mix stays as it is, in order.
cases.request: Add a calm ending to this mix.

cases.checks: Replacing most of the mix waits for the person to say yes.
cases.request: This is all wrong, make it warm instead.

cases.checks: Every tool call names a real tool with an object of arguments.
